# Release notes

## 0.3.0

Documents can now be compared with earlier versions from Git. Changes are
shown word by word, the way a reviewer would mark up a printed draft.

## 0.2.0

This release focuses on speed. Opening a folder with ten thousand files now takes
under a second, and search results stream in as they are found.

### Fixes

1. Fixed a crash when a file was renamed while it was open.
2. Fixed scrolling jumping to the top after saving.
3. The preview no longer flickers when typing quickly.
4. Emoji such as 👩‍💻 and CJK text like 日本語 now wrap correctly.

## 0.1.0

First public preview. Expect rough edges.
